subject: Onboarding orchestration: kickoff conductor call + L2 tech check
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding orchestration: kickoff conductor call + L2 tech check

Hi Sara / Tom —

Looking forward to kicking off the Acme Health implementation next week. To keep the launch smooth we propose two short coordinating meetings on the kickoff day:

1) "Conductor" call (30 min) — cross-functional sync to confirm roles, communication cadence, and success criteria. Attendees: customer PM, Redwood CSM (Monica), Solution Lead (Kim), Engineering on-call (Dev).

2) L2 tech check (15 min) — quick run of firewall/egress and SSO checks; Dev + Acme infra.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Option A: 2026-10-29 09:00–09:30
- Option B: 2026-10-29 11:00–11:30
- L2 tech check: 2026-10-29 08:30–08:45 (recommended pre-call)

Please confirm which window works and share any additional attendees (observers are fine). I attached a draft agenda and a roles spreadsheet so we can lock owners ahead of the call.

Quick asks:
- Confirm preferred conductor for the 30-min call (customer or Redwood?)
- Are there any orgs that need meeting-level approvals (security/compliance watchers)?

Thanks — I can send calendar invites as soon as you confirm Option A or B.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: kickoff-agenda-v1.pdf (1 page), MA-Implementation-Roles.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health IT <it@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration: kickoff conductor call + L2 tech check

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — Option B (11:00–11:30 PDT) works best for our team. We'll plan to have:
- Sara Jenkins (Customer PM) — conductor or co-conductor
- Tom Rivers (Infra lead) — primary for L2 tech check
- Demo/observability: Rachel Lin (will be cc'd in separate invite if needed)

IT note: our infra team needs the Zoom link and the egress IP ranges at least 24 hours before the L2 check. I've looped in Acme Health IT. If you have a short pre-call runbook that Dev can use, that would help.

Confirming attendees: Sara, Tom, Acme Health IT (it@acmehealth.com). Observers: Rachel Lin.

Sara
Sara Jenkins
Product Manager, Integrations | Acme Health
sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration: kickoff conductor call + L2 tech check

Perfect — Option B it is. I'll send two back-to-back calendar invites for 2026-10-29:
- 11:00–11:30 PDT: Onboarding Conductor (agenda attached)
- 10:45–11:00 PDT: L2 Tech check (short pre-call with Dev + Acme IT)

Quick notes for the conductor call (what I'll cover):
- Introductions and success metrics (5m)
- Roll assignment (who owns config, test plan, rollout gates) (10m)
- Communication/incident playbook and escalation path (5m)
- Next steps + action owners + timeline (10m)

Dev — can you prepare the tiny runbook for the L2 check (ports, sample curl, expected headers) and paste the checklist into the Drive link below? I'll attach the calendar invites and include the Drive runbook.

Drive runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Acme-Onboarding-Runbook

Thanks — I'll send invites in ~15 minutes.

Monica Patel
Senior CSM | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health IT <it@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration: kickoff conductor call + L2 tech check

Thanks — I'll drop the L2 checklist into Drive and will join the pre-call at 10:45 PDT. Checklist highlights I'll include:
- Confirm firewall egress to Zoom and Redwood inference endpoints (list of CIDRs)
- TLS handshake check and example curl to our /health endpoint (include token redaction guidance)
- SSO/SCIM smoke (if customer enabled SSO) — quick verify but not full SAML flow
- Post-call: artifact capture (troubleshooting logs snippet + tracer id)

Note: I need a 10-min buffer before 10:45 to spin up the debug VM (nothing to share, just FYI). If the team wants me to run a 5-min demo of the devtools after the conductor call, I can do that — let me know.

--
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-lfs-egress-cidrs.txt (list)
